claims.name: review-changed-nothing
claims.risk: a review that was asked to change nothing changed the repository

claims.name: defect-found
claims.risk: the review misses that the cache never removes an expired entry, or cites a line the file does not have
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/field.py" defect-found

claims.name: no-pass-beside-defect
claims.risk: a PASS stands beside the defect, on the reviewer's own scope, or as the verdict of a change that has a defect
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/field.py" no-pass-beside-defect

claims.name: verdict-given
claims.risk: the review ends with no verdict a person can act on
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/field.py" verdict-given
